purpose: Provide a deterministic, minimal-entry kernel so every agent reconstructs the relevant federated state before acting instead of relying on prompt memory.
principles: AGENTS.md is an entry router, not the sole source of truth.
Load the minimum relevant subgraph; do not crawl the whole universe by default.
TOKEN_VAZIO is a valid state and must never be coerced into zero, false, pass or resolved.
Urgency orders work; it does not increase epistemic confidence.
Local repository authority governs local implementation details; federation contracts govern cross-repository edges.
Evidence is bound to the exact commit, artifact, protocol, environment and device that produced it.
Historical observations are append-only; corrections supersede rather than rewrite receipts.
Documentation is not runtime evidence and hashes are not scientific validation.
Every mutation must have an observable exit criterion; high-risk mutation requires rollback.
Negative results are assets when the falsifier was actually exercised.
No cross-repository claim promotion from a single repository receipt.

entry_sequence.action: Bind repository, branch/ref, exact commit SHA and local AGENTS.md.
Identify local role and open only the canonical indices named by AGENTS.md.
Load unresolved gaps/TOKEN_VAZIO/uncertainty and their urgency, owner, provenance and dependencies.
Choose the next action by deterministic priority rules, not narrative salience.
Record baseline commit, affected files, invariants, tests, contracts and rollback reference before mutation.
Apply the smallest coherent change that can exercise an explicit falsifier or exit criterion.
Run repository-local tests and validators appropriate to the changed surface.
For cross-repository behavior, validate producer/consumer contracts on both sides and preserve any physical-runtime TOKEN_VAZIO.
Emit a transition receipt with F_ok, F_gap, F_next, evidence refs and uncertainty delta.
Append/supersede the ledger observation without rewriting historical evidence.

priority_rules: P0 safety, security, data-loss, rollback or execution blockers before lower urgency work.
Within the same urgency, unblock upstream dependencies before downstream consumers.
Prefer READY_TO_TEST items with observable exit criteria over speculative redesign.
Prefer a narrow action that reduces a named uncertainty over a broad refactor with no falsifier.
Prefer cross-repository blockers affecting multiple nodes over isolated cosmetic debt.
If still tied, process the oldest unresolved observation first.

federation_roles.rafgittools: control-plane: routing, governance, state axes, ledgers, gates and cross-repository contracts
federation_roles.termux_app: android-runtime: bootstrap, package identity, local execution services, device receipts and Vectra provider boundary
federation_roles.termux_packages: package-factory: source/package build contracts, prefix artifacts, hashes and handoff schemas
federation_roles.vectra: vm-consumer: bounded VM/QEMU request construction, Termux IPC consumer, safe-state and guest/runtime receipts
federation_roles.llama: governed-retrieval: ONES/CTI memory ingestion, retrieval provenance, privacy gate and semantic-evaluation boundary

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not infer RESOLVED from implementation presence.
Do not infer runtime success from dispatch acceptance.
Do not reuse VERIFIED from an older commit without explicit inherited-evidence rules.
Do not hide ignored/deferred work by deleting it from the ledger.
Do not copy another repository's local AGENTS.md specialization as if it were local authority.
Do not let symbolic/metaphorical language replace measurements or executable contracts.
